newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: WBH-Ovcon earnings lift after merger.
newsitem.headline: WBH-Ovcon earnings lift after merger.

text.p: Full name: Wilson Bayly Holmes - Ovcon Ltd
NOTE - The comparative period represents trading for the year to March 31.

From July 1 Ovcon Ltd merged with Wilson Bayly Holmes (Pty) Ltd and the enlarged building and civil engineering group changed its year end. The results represent twelve months trading for Wilson Bayly and fifteen months for Ovcon.

The firm said that it expected trading conditions to become more competitive in the next financial year. But it added it is optimistic about its prospects and has started the year with an order book of reasonable size and expects to show an increase in attributable earnings.
